versions.content: In case that the referenced ModeRule (see ECUC_Dcm_00943) is not fulfilled anymore for a NetworkHandle which is currently in a state other than DCM_ENABLE_RX_TX_NORM_NM, the Dcm shall: 1. switch the mode group Dcm_CommunicationControl_<Network> ModeDeclara- tionGroupPrototype toDCM_ENABLE_RX_TX_NORM_NM 2. call BswM_Dcm_CommunicationMode_CurrentState with the parameters Net- workHandleType set to the corresponding NetworkHandle of the network and RequestedCommunicationMode set to DCM_ENABLE_RX_TX_NORM_NM
